description: Chat with a Venice character by slug. Completion id and actual model, when returned upstream, are available in structured content. Responses marked X-Venice-TEE: true also include a JSON text block for venice_tee_signature. Note: the character lookup itself is API-key-only, but the chat completion supports x402 — so x402 users may need to fetch character info via API key first. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits.
name: venice_chat_with_character
title: Venice Character Chat
